name: gap_host_receive_slot

provenance.source: exact 3.101.043 IDB vela_ap.bin.i64; callback registration, direct dispatch wrapper, and 3.101.036 structural comparison

notes: Direct live raw-H4 callback slot. sub_C81234C copies *callback_holder into 0x2013C144 and stores callback state at 0x2013C140; sub_C8172C0 dispatches every completed H4 packet through those two words. This is the exact 3.101.043 analogue of the proven 3.101.036 slot 0x20137E94.
